title: Compounding Risk: Emergent Misalignment + Interpretability Failure — Misaligned Circuits That Resist Detection
original_idea: After inducing emergent misalignment in a small transformer, apply a suite of interpretability methods (attention visualization, activation probing, causal patching) and attempt to localize the misalignment circuit. Compare localization success rate to a behavioral detection baseline.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: emergent misalignment may produce distributed circuits -> standard interp methods fail to detect them -> interp-based safety audits are systematically blind. Each link is explicit and the safety implication (audit failure) is critical.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires inducing emergent misalignment in a transformer and applying multiple interpretability methods (attention viz, activation probing, causal patching). Each method requires non-trivial expertise. Advanced for beginner CS students.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Multiple interpretability methods must be applied and compared against a behavioral baseline. A first deliverable could be one method vs behavioral, but the idea's value comes from the full suite comparison, requiring sustained effort.
